source.sourceLessonTitleEnglish: Feedback to a Veteran Mason on Out-of-Plumb Block
source.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Give a veteran mason specific feedback on out-of-plumb block and agree on what you want to see tomorrow.

rows.japanese: 昼前、職長はロヘリオと壁の前で話しました。
rows.english: Before noon, the foreman spoke with Rogelio in front of the wall.

rows.japanese: 二人は、現場の測定記録を一緒に見ました。
rows.english: They looked at the site’s measurement record together.

rows.japanese: 職長は、気になった箇所を記録の上で示しました。
rows.english: The foreman pointed out the area of concern in the record.

rows.japanese: ロヘリオは、どの測定値を確認すべきか尋ねました。
rows.english: Rogelio asked which measurement they should check.

rows.japanese: 職長は、推測で結論を出さずに再確認したいと答えました。
rows.english: The foreman said he wanted to check again rather than draw a conclusion from a guess.

rows.japanese: 二人は、確認した数値とまだ不明な点を分けて書きました。
rows.english: They wrote the confirmed figures separately from the unresolved questions.

rows.japanese: 職長は、ロヘリオを責めるための会話ではないと伝えました。
rows.english: The foreman said the conversation was not about blaming Rogelio.

rows.japanese: 最後に、担当者と次の確認の時間を決めました。
rows.english: Finally, they set a time for the next check with the responsible person.

openDomainReview.question: Preserve the retail strip on Avenida Central, foreman Daniel Ortiz, master mason Rogelio Durán, helper Kevin Soto, and the corner leaning outward almost 1 inch out of plumb. Rogelio blames Kevin for not raising the line in time; Daniel assigns wall responsibility to Rogelio while acknowledging his work. A qualified Japanese/masonry reviewer must settle plumb bob, straightedge, level, out-of-plumb and workmanship terms and keep the personnel and attribution exact.

Preserve Daniel's request to take down the section before the mortar hardens, Rogelio removing block from the last four courses while the mortar is fresh, checking plumb on every course, and Kevin working alongside Rogelio and alerting Daniel to deviations. A qualified Japanese/masonry reviewer must settle course, mortar, trowel, line and block terminology and keep the narrated correction distinct from independent construction advice.

Preserve Daniel's plan for tomorrow, his request to see the corner before lunch, and Rogelio's specific agreement to check it together at 11 with straightedge and plumb bob. A qualified Japanese/source reviewer must retain the exact time and distinguish the request from a completed inspection; inspect conditional draft register before any learner or audio use.

rows.sourceSpanish: En una plaza comercial de la Avenida Central, el capataz Daniel Ortiz revisa el muro de block que levantó el maestro albañil Rogelio Durán.
rows.sourceEnglish: At a retail strip on Avenida Central, foreman Daniel Ortiz checks the block wall that master mason Rogelio Durán built.

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel pone la plomada en la esquina y ve que el muro se va hacia afuera.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel holds the plumb bob at the corner and sees that the wall leans outward.

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel: Rogelio, la esquina está fuera de plomo casi 1 pulgada.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel: Rogelio, the corner is almost 1 inch out of plumb.
rows.speaker: Daniel
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: ロヘリオさん、この角は垂直から1インチ近くずれています。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rogelio pone la regla y el nivel contra la esquina y confirma el desplome.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rogelio puts the straightedge and the level against the corner and confirms the lean.

rows.sourceSpanish: Rogelio señala a su ayudante, Kevin Soto, y dice: La culpa es de Kevin, porque no subió el hilo a tiempo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rogelio points to his helper, Kevin Soto, and says: It's Kevin's fault, because he didn't raise the line in time.
rows.speaker: Rogelio points to his helper, Kevin Soto, and says

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel: No se trata de culpar a Kevin; el muro lo diriges tú.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel: This isn't about blaming Kevin; you're the one running the wall.
rows.speaker: Daniel
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: これはケビンを責める話ではありません。この壁を任されているのはロヘリオさんです。

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel: Tu trabajo siempre ha sido bueno; por eso te lo digo directo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel: Your work has always been good; that's why I'm telling you straight.
rows.speaker: Daniel
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: ロヘリオさんはこれまでずっと良い仕事をしてくれています。だからこそ、率直にお伝えしています。

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel le explica que la mano de obra de toda la cuadrilla se juzga por las esquinas, porque es lo primero que ve el cliente.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel explains to him that the whole crew's workmanship is judged by the corners, because they're the first thing the client sees.

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel: Es mejor que quitemos este tramo antes de que endurezca el mortero.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel: We'd better take this section down before the mortar hardens.
rows.speaker: Daniel
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: モルタルが固まる前に、この区間を解体したほうがいいでしょう。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rogelio toma la cuchara y empieza a quitar el block de las últimas 4 hiladas mientras el mortero sigue fresco.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rogelio picks up the trowel and starts taking down the block from the last 4 courses while the mortar is still fresh.

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel: Te recomiendo que revises el plomo en cada hilada.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel: I recommend you check plumb on every course.
rows.speaker: Daniel
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 段ごとに垂直を確認することをお勧めします。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rogelio admite que tiene la costumbre de revisar el plomo solo al final del día, cuando ya es tarde para corregir.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rogelio admits that he has the habit of checking plumb only at the end of the day, when it's already too late to fix it.

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel: Prefiero que Kevin trabaje a tu lado y aprenda contigo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel: I'd rather have Kevin work next to you and learn from you.
rows.speaker: Daniel
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: ケビンには、ロヘリオさんの隣で作業して、ロヘリオさんから学んでもらいたいと思っています。

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel: Kevin, quiero que me avises si ves algo fuera de plomo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel: Kevin, I want you to tell me if you see anything out of plumb.
rows.speaker: Daniel
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: ケビン、垂直から外れているものを見つけたら、私に教えてほしいです。

rows.sourceSpanish: Kevin: Sí, jefe, voy a revisar con la plomada cada vez que Rogelio suba el hilo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Kevin: Yes, boss, I'm going to check with the plumb bob every time Rogelio raises the line.
rows.speaker: Kevin

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel se voltea otra vez hacia Rogelio para acordar el plan de mañana.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel turns back to Rogelio to agree on the plan for tomorrow.

rows.sourceSpanish: Daniel: Mañana quiero que me enseñes la esquina antes del almuerzo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Daniel: Tomorrow I want you to show me the corner before lunch.
rows.speaker: Daniel
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 明日は、昼食前にこの角を私に見せてほしいです。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Está bien, mañana a las 11 la revisamos juntos con la regla y la plomada.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: All right, tomorrow at 11 we'll check it together with the straightedge and the plumb bob.
rows.speaker: Rogelio
